free_tier.stated: Free plan: 30,000 calls a month at 1 request per second, community support; the sign-up page says no card is required
free_tier.notes: the API docs call the 1-request-per-second allowance a Free Trial, while the pricing page and the sign-up page list it as the Free plan at 30,000 calls a month

per_object_cap.stated: the API docs list one address or coordinate a request (q for /geocode, lat and lng for /reverse); the home page also offers batch geocoding and a dashboard upload of CSV or Excel spreadsheets, and whether the Free plan includes them is unverified

retention.stated: data returned from the API may be reproduced in applications with credit, and must not be cached, stored or persisted for more than 30 days

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in calls, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS GET to api.geocodify.com/v2 (/geocode, /reverse, /geoparse, /autocomplete, /parse, /elevation) with the key in an api_key parameter, JSON answers, CORS enabled; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401 with Missing or invalid api credentials
tooling: any HTTP client; a CSV and Excel upload tool in the dashboard
chaining: bulk work is single requests at 1 a second or the dashboard's spreadsheet upload

limits.value: 30,000 calls a month on the Free plan
1 request per second on the Free plan, answered with HTTP 429 beyond it
data returned from the API may be cached or stored for at most 30 days

binding_note: 1 request per second allows far more than 30,000 calls in a month, so the monthly allowance is met first

identity_cost.detail: an account at geocodify.com/signup with a first name, last name, email and password, or Google or GitHub sign-in; the page says no card is required

reliability_note: the docs warn that a 200 OK can be returned even when usage limits are reached or parameters are missing, with the details in the JSON meta field; past 1 request per second the API answers HTTP 429
confidence_note: the pricing page, the API docs, the terms, the sign-up page and the home page were quoted on 2026-11-02; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401. No account was opened, so the free monthly allowance was not exercised.
